site.name: Coordenada Geo
site.tagline: Specialised geospatial technology for land, rural production and the environment
site.description: Coordenada Geo is a specialised geospatial-technology firm: a web platform for origin traceability and socio-environmental compliance, plus remote sensing, geoprocessing and bespoke solution development — turning spatial data into decisions about land, production and the environment.

hero.eyebrow: For those who decide about land, production and the environment
hero.title: Spatial data turned into applied knowledge
hero.subtitle: We combine a web platform for origin traceability and socio-environmental compliance with specialised remote sensing and geoprocessing services — for those who produce on the land, care for the environment and decide about the territory, from assessment to operation.

about.title: Geospatial specialists, from science to operation
about.body: Coordenada Geo works at the interface of science, technology and territorial management. The demand for transparency has grown: new rules for credit, exports and markets now require proof of origin and socio-environmental compliance. We help those who produce on the land, those who care for the environment and those who decide about the territory respond to that with method and clarity — delivering value in two complementary ways: a web platform that makes traceability and compliance accessible and practical, and specialised remote sensing, geoprocessing and bespoke development services for the challenges that go beyond what is already in the platform.
bullets: A platform as the fast track — and bespoke services when the problem is unique.
Scientific rigour when choosing data, methods and validations, with iterative delivery.
An explicit social-environmental commitment: transparency for people, territories and ecosystems.

purpose.title: Spatial knowledge for more conscious decisions about the territory
purpose.body: To turn geographic data into applied knowledge: to make the origin of products verifiable, socio-environmental compliance accessible, and decisions about the territory more conscious — with technical rigour, in favour of more transparent markets and protected ecosystems.

items.title: Technical precision
items.body: Scientific rigour when choosing methods, data and validations, without sacrificing clarity.

items.title: Collaboration
items.body: We build solutions close to the client, integrating technical and domain expertise.

items.title: Adaptability
items.body: We adjust scope, tools and deliverables to the reality of each project and scale.

items.title: Social-environmental purpose
items.body: We prioritise initiatives that generate positive impact on people, territories and ecosystems.

platform.title: Traceability and compliance, made accessible and practical
platform.body: Our flagship product puts socio-environmental compliance within reach of every link in the chain. You indicate your suppliers' areas — the polygons of rural properties, plots and production areas — and the platform cross-references them with the datasets that matter: deforestation alerts, areas embargoed by IBAMA, conservation units, indigenous lands and other protected areas. The result is a report per supplier, with the overlaps, history and data provenance in an auditable record — ready to prove origin in audits and meet credit, export and market requirements. Each organisation has its own isolated environment, with APIs to integrate with your procurement process.

services.title: When the challenge calls for a bespoke solution
services.intro: The platform handles the most common path. For other challenges, we work end to end in remote sensing, geoprocessing and geospatial development — from assessment to operation, with validated methods and trusted datasets.

items.title: Applied remote sensing
items.body: Satellite imagery analysis for change detection, deforestation and regeneration, land use and land cover, burn scars, water resources and environmental liabilities.

items.title: Geoprocessing and spatial analysis
items.body: Geographic data modelling, map algebra, spatial statistics and cross-referencing of public and proprietary datasets to answer questions about the territory.

items.title: Dashboards and visualisation
items.body: Interactive maps and web panels to follow indicators, areas of interest and time series.

items.title: Automation and data pipelines
items.body: Geospatial ETL, integration with public APIs and orchestration of data collection, processing and publishing.

items.title: Bespoke geospatial platforms and APIs
items.body: Development of geospatial web applications and APIs, from prototype to production.

items.title: Training and technical support
items.body: Training, code reviews and mentoring for teams working with geographic data.

items.title: Rural production and supply chains
items.body: Origin traceability, supplier verification and meeting credit, export and market requirements.

items.title: Environment and climate
items.body: Deforestation and regeneration, vegetation cover, protected areas, environmental liabilities and risk.

items.title: Territory and land use
items.body: Characterisation of rural properties, land use and occupation dynamics, regularisation and CAR status.

items.title: Public sector and infrastructure
items.body: Inputs for planning and territorial policy, programme monitoring and analysis of assets and networks.
